name: pbl4-web
description: PBL4_Web - Healthcare & Neuroscience social networking platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "db,api,ui" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run db:start" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
